attributes.action: Stop Abusive parking charging and practices
attributes.additional_details:
Petition: Reform Penalty Charge Notices (PCNs)
We call on local authorities to ensure fair and transparent use of PCNs.
attributes.background:
Petition: Reform Penalty Charge Notices (PCNs)
 Councils must publish how much revenue is generated and how it is spent. Motorists should retain the right to pay the reduced rate when making an informal challenge. PCN charges capped at maximum daily parking fee in the local area.

rejection.details:
The maximum amount for a PCNs are capped, however this cap is different depending on which region you are in.

This document sets out the minimum data that local authorities should be publishing, the frequency it should be published and how it should be published:
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/local-government-transparency-code-2015/local-government-transparency-code-2015
